title: Woolworths Limited - proposed acquisition of Liquor licence located in Rydalmere NSW
targets: Liquor licence located in Rydalmere NSW

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Woolworths proposed to acquire the licence and goodwill of a takeaway packaged liquor licencee located in Rydalmere, NSW.  The licence is located at Shops 2 and 3, 72 Pine Street, Rydalmere, NSW and trades as "David's Cellars".
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of the following markets: - a local retail market for the supply of liquor for off-premises consumption, with a 3-5 km geographic radius surrounding the target; and - a state-based wholesale market for the supply and procurement of packaged liquor products for   subsequent sale in the retail market for off-premises consumption.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. In forming this view, the ACCC had regard to the following factors: - in the retail market, Woolworths would continue to be constrained by a number of other retail liquor    outlets; and - in the wholesale market, the proposed acquisition was unlikely to significantly increase the buying power    of Woolworths, nor diminish the buying power of competing wholesale purchasers.
